title: ImportError: No module named psycopg2
body:
After changing settings to try and use a PostgreSQL DB I'm getting the following:

`-- The start-up result is done.
Mar 27 16:29:55 matrix python[3555]: 2017-03-27 16:29:55,490 - twisted - 131 - ERROR - - Traceback (most recent call last):

Mar 27 16:29:55 matrix python[3555]: 2017-03-27 16:29:55,498 - twisted - 131 - ERROR - - ImportError: No module named psycopg2
Mar 27 16:29:55 matrix systemd[1]: matrix-synapse.service: Main process exited, code=exited, status=1/FAILURE
Mar 27 16:29:55 matrix systemd[1]: matrix-synapse.service: Unit entered failed state.

I've install psycopg2 with pip.  Trying again only yields:
 
`ripley@matrix:~$ pip install psycopg2
Requirement already satisfied: psycopg2 in ./.local/lib/python2.7/site-packages
`

OS: Ubuntu16.04LTS
Synapse: 0.19.3-1 (From the Debian package repo)
